title: Characteristic cycles and non-acyclicity classes for constructible étale sheaves
summary: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism between smooth schemes over a perfect field $k$. Let $\mathcal F$ be a constructible sheaf on $X$ and $Z$ a closed subscheme of $X$ such that $f$ is $SS(\mathcal F)$-transversal outside $Z$. We construct a class supported on the non-transversal locus $Z$ by using the characteristic cycle $CC(\mathcal F)$ defined by T. Saito. This class is a geometric counterpart of the non-acyclicity class introduced by the third author and Zhao in [Invent. Math. 240 (2025), 123-191].
